initial_actual_state.method: per-body piecewise-linear interpolated initial guess, nearest source node outside old chordal hull; not a prescribed/solved final field

wire_model: conservative hybrid1D flux callbacks in the coupled global nonlinear solve
TEC_profile: original mixed constant verification law, no OEM-grade accuracy
enclosure_model: 3D solids + nonlocal gray radiosity, rarefied gas films, gold/TEC supply leads; no gas CFD
nonlocal_iteration: depth4 regularized Anderson on boundary powers; same physical fixed point, independently checked by final unaccelerated field residuals
lead_electrical_model: imposed module series I; lumped Cu lead resistance/Joule, not spatial detector/lead current transport
